description: Creators only, on their own Piku account (asks them to connect). Propose a design for the creator's page as a Page draft: any of the look (theme and buttons), bio, link titles, the order of links, widgets, sections and Rates, and new links or widgets from addresses the creator gave you. Every field is optional; give only what changes. Nothing on the live page changes: the creator previews the Page draft and applies it, or parts of it, in the page builder. A new design replaces the open one. Returns the draft_id, the changes by part (Look, Order, Text, New links) and a preview_url.

add.description: New links or widgets, only from addresses the creator gave you. Links must be https.

url.description: For type link: an https address

value.description: For a widget: its https link, or the WhatsApp number with country code

links_order.description: Link and widget ids in the new order; new:0 is the first item of add. Ones left out follow in their order.

look.description: The page's theme and buttons. Fonts and custom backgrounds are not available.

button_align.description: Where titles sit on the buttons

button_colour.description: Like #4A2073. get_page lists the named ones

theme.description: Background, surfaces, text and accent together. get_page lists them

rates_order.description: Rate ids in the new order. Ones left out follow.

sections.description: The tabs shown, in order. The first opens first.

titles.description: New titles for links or widgets, by id from get_page

name: design_page
title: Draft a page design
